name: Pullman Danang Beach Resort
description:
Experience world-class service at Pullman Danang Beach ResortPullman Danang Beach Resort is situated on Bac My An Beach, 3 km from downtown Da Nang. It offers an outdoor pool and spa. Free WiFi and parking are provided.

Pullman Danang Beach Resort is about 8 km from Da Nang International Airport. It provides two-way airport transfer services at an additional charge.

Rooms at Pullman Danang come with private balconies offering garden, sea or pond views. Each room is equipped with a TV, fridge and safety deposit box. En suite bathrooms have a separate bathtub and shower.

Guests can work out at the fitness centre, or rent a bicycle to explore the neighbourhood. Water sports equipment are also available for guests’ enjoyment. Other facilities include a tour desk and tennis courts.

Restaurant Epice features an open kitchen where guests can watch the chefs prepare local specialities.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
